record.field: India monthly payroll: Provident Fund (wage-ceiling), ESI (eligibility-ceiling), Professional Tax, and TDS via the FY2025-26 new-regime slabs with the ₹75,000 standard deduction and the section 87A rebate (nil tax up to ₹12L taxable). Rates come from the India legislation pack. Professional tax is a flat monthly slab (state-specific) and TDS marginal relief near the rebate edge is not modelled — v1 limitations.
